figurative_meaning_en: Educating a fool to make them clever or wise
similar_in_english: Turning a sow's ear into a silk purse
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার বোকা ভাইকে গাধা পিটিয়ে ঘোড়া করার চেষ্টা করছে।
শিক্ষকরা প্রায়ই ছাত্রদের গাধা পিটিয়ে ঘোড়া করেন।
example_sentences_in_english: He is trying to turn his foolish brother into a smart one by educating him relentlessly.
Teachers often attempt to beat the donkey into a horse with their students.
note: The idiom uses animal imagery common in rural Bengali folklore to emphasize the effort required for personal improvement.
